title: Ing Tronu ning Katutuan
intro: Ing metung a mayupayang pekapun, a kilala king karelang maragul a kabiasnan at mangasanting a tronu, tinanggap yang misteryosung mensahi ibat king e na balung pikuanan. Ing e asaan a komunikasyun ayni lalabag ya kareng karelang kapaniwalan ampo awtoridad, a magdala karela keng diplomatic a pamaglakbe na magsubuk keng karelang kaisipan at keng katataulian magdalang malalam a espiritual a pamaggising. Malyari meng abalu ing pangatau na niting soberanu at ding milyari a mekapagbayu king mabilug dang kayarian?
clues: Aku at ding memalen ku simban mi ya ing aldo, tikian mi ing paralan da ring makatua mi.
Ing ayup, ing hoopoe, ya ing e malyaring tubud a migdala kanaku sulat ibat king metung a mayupayang lider.
Para subukan ing kabiasnan ning mitubud, peparala kung maulagang regalu, pero mibalik la, uling ing mitubud atin yang mas maragul a pibandian ibat kang Allah.
Bayu ku pa man miras keng husgadu ning mitubud, ing kanakung makabaldugan a tronu milagru yang midala karin keng kimut ning mata.
Inyang miras ku, kitang da kanaku nung ing tronu a midala kanaku ya, at mekibat ku, 'Iti ya ing mismung metung.'

linub ku keng maragul a hall na ating sapin a aisip kung metung a talaga ning danum, at keng penandit a ita ning pangabigla, binie ke ing sarili ku kayabe nang Propeta Sulaiman kang Allah, ing Ginu da reng yatu.

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
